description: Does a summit, destination or point lie in an avalanche warning region of the Alps, in which one, and does it have a current report? Takes the name of a place or of a region, or up to 20 points such as start and summit of a tour. Also names other regions within 2 km.

lang.description: Language for region names and, if the service publishes in it, report texts. Default en.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS 84. topo^alpin covers the Alps only.

query.description: Name of a summit, hut, pass or town, or of an area such as Valais or Tyrol for all its warning regions, or of a warning region.

name: avalanche_region

appUrl.description: Opens this in the topo^alpin app. Share it with the user.

dataStale.description: True: the data is older than its source is refreshed, or the source reports a fault. Say that it may be outdated. null: unknown, not fresh.

dataUpdatedAt.description: When the data behind this answer was produced (ISO 8601, UTC; a date for a fixed release). With several sources, the oldest. null: unknown.

disclaimer.description: Pass this on with every danger level: errors in processing are possible.

missing.description: Present where a report is missing. Pass it on.

namedRegions.description: Regions whose own name matches the query.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app. Share it.

missingReason.description: Why there is no report. service_unavailable means we do not know: fetching it failed.

appUrl.description: Opens this place with the report of its region in the topo^alpin app.

inRegion.description: Does the place lie in a warning region?

nearby.description: Other regions within 2 km, each with its own report or that it has none.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app. Share it.

missingReason.description: Why there is no report. service_unavailable means we do not know: fetching it failed.

regions.description: Several only where the boundary is not certain.

appUrl.description: Opens this report in the topo^alpin app. Share it.

missingReason.description: Why there is no report. service_unavailable means we do not know: fetching it failed.

type.description: peak, saddle, alpine_hut, wilderness_hut, shelter, tour_place (where our tours start or end), town, or point where lat and lon were given.

sources.description: Name these when using the data.

title: Warning region of a place
